note: Static lake specifications are sourced from authoritative agency pages. Time-sensitive values should be fetched live or linked to the official source rather than copied here.

ok-sardis.angler_note: ODWC identifies Sardis as a strong bass fishery and publishes recurring fishing reports and lake-level links.

ok-mcgee-creek.manager: Bureau of Reclamation / Oklahoma State Parks
ok-mcgee-creek.angler_note: ODWC notes annual Florida-strain largemouth stocking and identifies McGee Creek as one of Oklahoma's top spring trophy-bass lakes.

ok-eufaula.regulation_note: All crappie: 20 per day. Snagging is closed for one mile below Eufaula Dam. Verify current ODWC regulations before fishing.
ok-eufaula.angler_note: ODWC describes Eufaula as Oklahoma's largest reservoir and an excellent crappie, white bass and catfish fishery; Florida-strain largemouth are stocked frequently.

ok-broken-bow.manager: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers / Oklahoma State Parks
ok-broken-bow.angler_note: Deep, clear reservoir with largemouth, smallmouth and spotted bass; ODWC publishes current fishing reports and a USACE lake-level link.

ok-grand.regulation_note: All crappie: 15 combined per day with a 10-inch minimum. Special methods restrictions apply below Pensacola Dam; verify current ODWC regulations before fishing.
ok-grand.angler_note: Grand is a major Oklahoma tournament fishery. ODWC notes regular hybrid-striped-bass stocking and recent Florida-strain largemouth stocking.

mo-table-rock.manager: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Little Rock District
mo-table-rock.dam_note: Table Rock Dam has four 50,000-kW generating units. Generation status must be checked live; this profile does not infer whether units are currently generating.
mo-table-rock.angler_note: USACE describes Table Rock as a clear-water Ozark reservoir with extensive marina and recreation access.
